exposure: Model of care (midwifery continuity of care vs. non-continuity of care)
Model of care (private vs. midwifery continuity of care)
Number of previous caesareans (one vs. two)
cohort: Women who gave birth in 2021 with one or two previous caesareans and were eligible to attempt VBAC
finding: The study found that midwifery continuity of care (CoC) was associated with a higher rate of both attempted and successful VBAC compared to non-CoC models, likely due to increased counselling and greater provision of birth choices.
mod_finding: Women in CoC models were more likely to attempt and achieve VBAC.
